stage: AAI-02A frozen task and baseline admission (no candidate mechanism promoted)
question: Can a bounded shared event memory preserve causally diagnostic interventions amid conflicting or distracting associations, and does the test actually leave room over strong exact and trained controls?

predecessor.finding: AAI-01 tied exact symbolic and fully trained comparator; unrelated C facts occupied separate capacity, so no shared-memory interference was shown.

frozen_task.generator: Deterministic stdlib random.Random(seed). Each world: assign three distinct causal role IDs A,B,C among 8 IDs uniformly; latent FORK versus CHAIN with equal prior; passive records are (A,B,C)=(0,0,0) or (1,1,1), observationally indistinguishable. Under intervention do(C=1) starting A=0, FORK has B=0, CHAIN has B=1; do(A=1) produces B=1 under both laws. Reported B under active probes is independently flipped with probability 0.20. Score policy: choose do(A=1) if FORK, else do(C=1), with equal costs/reward for choosing correct law; no oracle at inference.
frozen_task.input: Each episode gets exactly 4 passive observations and up to 3 probe actions, with output of each action made available only after it is selected. Three probe events then 0/16/64 timestamped irrelevant edge events arrive; all events compete for the same 8-slot capacity. Evaluation starts after distractions. No true law label during episode or test. Train worlds have full law labels after the episode; DEV/transfer worlds do not.
frozen_task.relation_shift: Transfer permutes visible node IDs and distractor timestamps independently; no repeated world seed.
frozen_task.memory: Shared 8 event slots; each causal or distractor event counts 1; selection metadata and model parameters accounted separately; zero retrieval of evicted observations; no disconnected protected distractor store.
frozen_task.probes: 3 actions each with equal response budget; active informative policy can select do(C); passive comparator selects do(A); random comparator selects each equiprobably from keyed hash.
frozen_task.scoring: Balanced accuracy on final law/policy decision, conditional on causal type and volume, plus three-probe informativeness and counterfactual role-swap consistency; report macroaverage by seed and cold-restore equality.
frozen_task.identifiability: Check passive distributions identical under matched random choices, do(A) response equal under both laws, do(C) response differs pre-noise and post-noise identifiable above chance; exact Bayes has ceiling >50% with three do(C) probes.
frozen_task.budget: No paid APIs, model calls, protected cohorts or first-use; 32 train + 32 DEV + 32 transfer +32 negative, 3 probes per episode, <=8 retained events; measure total generation, learning, test and serialization time; run two byte-identical repeats.

controls: Exact Bayesian evidence accumulator with same capacity (ceiling control).
Fully trained conventional 2-feature logistic classifier on the same labeled training worlds, documented convergence criterion BCE<=0.70 and exactly 2000 full-batch epochs max.
Event-relevance priority using hand-authored do(C) significance, same capacity.
Passive do(A) and random-action probe policies.
Counterfactual causal law swapped while observational samples remain identical.
Scrambled action labels and zero-probe negatives, expected at chance.

bench_admission.identifiable: Informative probe improves over passive by at least 20 percentage points averaged over DEV and TRANSFER.
bench_admission.nontrivial: Strongest feasible, capacity-matched non-oracle control accuracy must be <0.95 and >0.55 in 64-distractor condition.
bench_admission.validity: Identical equalized actions/observations across relevant arms, no leakage, source/memory accounting, all negative controls and convergence PASS.
bench_admission.on_no_go: Preserve failed benchmark and do not optimize associative mechanism on this task; design a new separately frozen harder task.

scientific_pass: NONE at this gate: benchmark admission is not evidence of a superior associative mechanism. A separate candidate preregistration and independent qualifying experiment are required before target-model integration.

classification_rules.pass: BENCHMARK_ADMITTED_DEV only if all bench_admission criteria and controls pass; no model integration.
classification_rules.fail: BENCHMARK_REJECTED_DEV if valid but saturated, too easy, or unidentifiable.
classification_rules.invalid: INVALID if leakage, unequal exposure, control nonconvergence, missing provenance, or changed prereg after data.

prohibited: Treat benchmark test as independent original scientific evidence
Model, main, production, accepted-ref, controller, runner, queue or loop writes
Use this branch to integrate into Wingless, Hybrid or weight-programming models
preregistration_note: Commit this file alone before generating any AAI-02 outcomes; post-freeze revisions only as separately versioned explicit new experiments.
